summary: Architectural implementation plan to completely resolve all 12 Voice Model issues on Blackbell AGI (Netlify/Vercel/Mobile). Implements a unified 4-state voice machine (Idle, Listening, Processing, Speaking), eliminates microphone/speaker audio feedback, prevents speech-recognition chime thrashing ('tu-tu-tu'), prevents duplicate overlapping playback using a Web Audio single-source pipeline with HTML5 fallback, stops topic bleeding via AbortControllers, and applies an adaptive 800ms speech pause detector.
